summary.intent: Execute Phase 19.1 (Extract Core Crypto SDK as Shared Package) end-to-end, including debugging a complex checkpoint verification for Plan 05 that uncovered deep integration issues between the new SDK and the legacy web app service layer.
summary.outcome: All 6 plans completed, 11/11 requirements verified, 9/9 Playwright E2E operations passing, security review conducted with all pre-review findings resolved or accepted. Phase 19.1 marked complete with 193 unit tests + 2 integration tests green.

repo: The @cipherbox/api-client generated functions require setApiClientConfig() to be called before use — this was never wired up in the web app, causing all SDK IPNS operations to silently fail
FolderEntry.id is a UUID used for UI navigation/store lookup, while ipnsName (k51...) is used for IPNS operations — these are distinct and must not be conflated
The web app's old services and the new SDK both write to the same IPNS records — any dual-path architecture causes 409 conflicts from stale sequence numbers
SDK's loadBin() must return an empty BinState (not null) on fresh accounts so deleteToBin() works before the first bin IPNS record is published
ensureFolderRegistered should skip if SDK already has the folder — re-registering overwrites the SDK's correct sequence number and IPNS private key with stale store values
The bin IPNS name is deterministically derived from the user's private key via deriveBinIpnsKeypair — both old service and SDK can independently derive the same name
OTPs for local dev login come from the backgrounded pnpm dev task output file (grep for 'DEV OTP for'), not from the database or Web3Auth test credentials
The e2e/page-objects/file-browser/upload-zone.page.ts uses setInputFiles() on the hidden file input — this is the correct approach for Playwright uploads, not clicking the visible upload zone
createFolder() must return the folder entry UUID (id) alongside ipnsName — the store uses UUID for lookups, not ipnsName
Destroying a CipherBoxClient must zero all key material (privateKey, publicKey, rootFolderKey) to prevent key material lingering in GC'd memory

code.finding: btoa(String.fromCharCode(...recordBytes)) will stack overflow for large byte arrays — use a loop-based uint8ToBase64 helper instead
customInstance created a new axios.create() instance on every API call — instance should be cached after setApiClientConfig() and reused
saveBinMetadata was called with 4-field manual destructure from BinOperationContext at every call site — simplified to accept BinOperationContext directly
Dynamic imports (encryptFile, addToIpfs) inside a per-file for loop cause unnecessary async round-trips — hoist before the loop
_sdkUnsubscribe stored as Zustand state triggers re-renders on every subscription change — should be a module-level variable
String-matching on (binErr as Error).message?.includes('Bin not loaded') is fragile — replaced with BinNotLoadedError class and instanceof check
.buffer cast on Uint8Array risks using the underlying ArrayBuffer's full length — use .slice().buffer per project coding guidelines
Object.values(folders).find(f => f.ipnsName === event.ipnsName) is an O(N) scan on every folder:loaded/updated event — a reverse lookup map would be O(1)

workflow: When the SDK integration test requires a running API, start pnpm dev before running tests — don't skip integration tests just because the API isn't up
Playwright MCP headed sessions are preferable to asking the user to drive — use mcp__playwright__browser_evaluate to click hidden file inputs, read OTPs from the backgrounded server log file
Use fresh random emails per Playwright test run to avoid accumulated IPNS records causing slow vault sync and auth constraint violations
Atomic commits per fix make bisect and review much easier — resist the urge to batch unrelated fixes
When two independent writers modify the same IPNS record, any state-sync bridge will create edge cases — the correct fix is eliminating the dual-path, not patching the sync
Three parallel code review agents (reuse, quality, efficiency) efficiently cover the full diff with clear separation of concerns
Security review should cross-reference the pre-implementation review findings explicitly — tracking which were fixed vs accepted vs still open

friction: 1Password SSH signing agent is inaccessible from Claude subprocesses — commits blocked until user unlocked manually, leaving staged changes in limbo
OTP rate limit (5 sends per 15 minutes, Redis-backed) blocked re-login attempts during Playwright testing — required Redis key deletion to recover
pnpm dev being killed/restarted mid-session invalidated OTPs and broke in-progress Playwright tests
auth_methods duplicate key constraint failures when reusing the same test email across multiple sessions
classifyHandoffIfNeeded Claude Code runtime bug caused agents to report failure despite completing successfully — required spot-check workaround
Playwright file upload required browser_evaluate to find and click the hidden input because the upload zone overlay intercepted pointer events
Vault sync on login takes 30+ seconds due to IPNS delegated routing retries, making E2E test iteration slow
Integration tests initially skipped because the agent couldn't start pnpm dev — the user had to explicitly instruct that the agent should start the dev environment itself
open_items: Batch SDK operations: moveItems, deleteItems, restoreFromBinBatch — currently N sequential IPNS publishes instead of O(1) batch publish per affected folder
Duplicate bin loading on login: initializeBin (old service) + loadBin (SDK) both resolve the same IPNS record and decrypt the same metadata — Plan 06 deprecated old service but didn't remove it
@internal methods on CipherBoxClient (getConfig, getFolderTree, getContext, emitEvent) are public TypeScript — getConfig exposes vault private key to any consumer
O(N) linear scan in folder.store.ts on every SDK folder:loaded/updated event — needs reverse lookup map (ipnsName → folderId)
uint8ToBase64 exists in 3 places (sdk-core/file, web/folder.service, web/file-metadata.service) — should be consolidated in @cipherbox/crypto
TEE key wrapping pattern (hexToBytes → wrapKey → bytesToHex) duplicated across sdk-core/folder, sdk-core/file, sdk/bin — needs shared helper
Constants IPNS_LIFETIME_MS, MAX_VERSIONS_PER_FILE, BIN_METADATA_VERSION duplicated between SDK packages and web services — should be exported from @cipherbox/core
revokeShare and reWrapForRecipients in SDK take injected API function callbacks instead of calling @cipherbox/api-client directly — leaks wiring responsibility to consumers
useFolderMutations still imports from deprecated web share service instead of SDK share module
resyncFolder in folder-helpers.ts imports from deprecated folder.service.ts fetchAndDecryptMetadata instead of sdk-core equivalent
MAX_FOLDER_DEPTH still defined in 3 places (folder.service.ts, folder-helpers.ts, MoveDialog.tsx)
